name: Alfauir (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a yellow lion rampant beneath a red cardinal's hat with fifteen tassels on each side.
history: The official flag of Alfauir is of proportions 2:3, blue, with a lion rampant or at the centre surmounted by a red hat with fifteen tassels arranged in five rows; it was approved by resolution of 28 September 2001 of the Conseller of Justice and Public Administrations and published in the DOGV of 30 October 2001. The arms had been approved by resolution of 21 May 1998.

features.role: cardinal's hat with tassels above the lion
